before-epoch-start.description: authority whose epoch starts after the certified round

big-epoch-authority.description: the authority of root epoch 2^64-3 (same keys): for the vector with large uint64 fields

config-pin-ok.description: pins the shard configuration hash of the corpus partition

default.description: trusted authority of the fixture network, the aggregation partition (7), unsharded, no end boundary

epoch-end-after.description: authenticated end of the epoch is after the certified round (still valid)

epoch-end-at-round.description: the next epoch starts at the certified round: the seal is at the retirement boundary and not valid

shard-00.description: shard 00 of the four shard partition

shard-00-config-pin-ok.description: shard 00 pinning its own configuration hash

shard-01.description: shard 01 of the four shard partition

shard-10.description: shard 10 of the four shard partition

shard-11.description: shard 11 of the four shard partition

untrusted-authority.description: a different authority (other keys, same network and node IDs)

wrong-epoch.description: authority of the next epoch with the same keys: seals of epoch 1 must not verify

wrong-network.description: authority of another network with the same keys and node IDs
